description: Offline corpus-grounded domain probes, NOT observed user traffic or a relevance training set. Expectations are source-based and must not be derived from retrieved results.
schema: Each case has a unique id, query text (Tantivy Boolean/phrase syntax), limit 1..50, optional exact workload (null or lower-hyphen directory), fuzzy 0..2, grounding, and expected. Expected kind source_path means at least one of the returned top-limit sections has exactly value; source_prefix means at least one source_path starts with value; no_hits requires an empty result set and value null. Source paths must be safe docs-relative paths with exactly .md, .yml or .yaml extensions, including indexed Landing/Hub pages. A false judgment is retained and causes a nonzero benchmark exit. Counts describe returned sections, not distinct articles. Schema 1 permits 1..32 cases, at most 2048 UTF-8 bytes per query, and no credentials, network or custom executable arguments.
